# Utah Pergola Experts

> Pergolas, motorized louvered roofs, and pavilions on Utah's Wasatch Front —
> timber structures with concrete footings, snow-load engineering, and
> finishes made for high-altitude sun. Design-build, quotes in writing.

## About

Utah Pergola Experts builds shade structures like structures, not furniture:
posts set in concrete footings below frost line, spans engineered for Utah
snow, thru-bolted connections, and UV-stable finishes. Structures are designed
around how the sun actually crosses your yard. A Spravek company, alongside
Alpine Fence & Deck, SPX Construction, Harlow Landscapes, Braddock Concrete,
and Relentless Equipment.

- Region: Utah — Wasatch Front (based in Utah County)
- Cities served: Lehi, Salt Lake City, Sandy, Draper, Alpine, Highland,
  Pleasant Grove, Provo, Saratoga Springs, Eagle Mountain, American Fork,
  Orem, Herriman, Riverton, Bluffdale
- Counties served: Salt Lake, Utah, Summit, Davis, Wasatch
- Price tier: residential ($$)

## Frequently asked

### How do quotes work?
Call, text, or send the quote form. We walk the yard, map the sun, and put
drawings, materials, and price in writing — before any work starts.

### Will a pergola survive Utah snow?
Ours will. Spans are engineered for snow load, posts are set in concrete
footings below frost line, and louvered roofs shed snow like a solid roof.
That's the difference between a structure and a kit.

### Are you part of a larger company?
Yes. Utah Pergola Experts is part of the Alpine Fence & Deck family of
companies — a Spravek company — twenty years of construction craft on the
Wasatch Front, under one accountability line.
